S5_module_matrix.note: rest pose of the approved module GLBs, FX meshes excluded. Clearance is tested against convex pieces: for convex blocks the hull of each variant's own mesh, for non-convex blocks (Step, CornerL3, Tee4, Arch, CoveEdge, Dome, TrussCube) the approved analytic parts, which contain both visuals (S2). Blocked spins are counted for both variants; a regression is any case where A is worse than the approved block.
